description: This Java class 'WeightPackageSession' manages shipment packaging, including creating package lines, calculating costs, updating shipment segments, and handling UPS integration within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: WeightPackageSession
classes.description: Manages shipment weight packages, including package creation, cost calculation, UPS integration, and shipment updates.

methods.name: createWeightPackageLine
methods.description: Creates a new package line with specified dimensions and shipment box type.

methods.name: getShippableWeight
methods.description: Calculates total weight of packed lines for a given order.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Finalizes shipment packaging, calculates costs, updates shipment and order statuses, and handles UPS integration if applicable.

methods.name: upsShipmentConfirm
methods.description: Confirms shipment with UPS and retrieves actual shipping cost.

methods.name: upsShipmentAccept
methods.description: Accepts shipment with UPS after confirmation.

methods.name: diffInShipCost
methods.description: Checks if the difference between estimated and actual shipping costs exceeds allowed percentage.

methods.name: createPackages
methods.description: Creates shipment packages based on packed lines.

methods.name: changeOrderItemStatus
methods.description: Updates order item statuses to completed.

methods.name: applyItemsToPackages
methods.description: Associates order items with shipment packages.

methods.name: updateShipmentRouteSegments
methods.description: Updates shipment route segments with total weight and UOM.

methods.name: getShipmentCostEstimate
methods.description: Calculates estimated shipment cost based on various parameters.

methods.name: savePackagesInfo
methods.description: Creates packages and performs UPS confirmation if needed.

methods.name: getOrderedQuantity
methods.description: Retrieves total ordered quantity for an order.
